item.title: Oji Zoo: Kobe's Family Zoo Under the Cherry Trees — Guide
item.description: Oji Zoo is Kobe’s much-loved city zoo, a compact and refreshingly inexpensive place set in parkland between Nada and Sannomiya. Its collection covers the usual favourites — elephants, big cats, giraffes and a well-known group of koalas — alongside a small old-fashioned amusement corner with rides for younger children and a preserved Meiji-era Western residence in the grounds. In spring the zoo’s cherry trees make it one of the best hanami spots in central Kobe, when families picnic under the blossoms between animal enclosures.
